dedupe_keys.name: fao aquastat database on investment costs in irrigation 2003 archived

description: This AQUASTAT database gives investment costs for 248 irrigation projects in developing regions, analysed in a standard format from several hundred appraisal documents, completion reports and articles, mainly from the FAO Investment Centre and the World Bank. Projects are grouped into five regions, East Asia, South Asia, sub-Saharan Africa, the Near East and North Africa, and Latin America and the Caribbean, and described by governance, gravity or pumped water supply, irrigation technology and whether they are new schemes or rehabilitation and modernisation, with all costs converted to US dollars at 2000 prices. It was compiled by the Food and Agriculture Organization in a 2003 desk study. For sub-Saharan Africa, for example, it holds 57 projects in 13 countries covering 107,762 hectares from 1980 to 2003. The Excel file is free to download from the AQUASTAT archive; no licence is stated. Caveats: FAO itself calls the asset extraordinarily outdated, kept online at users' request, and most figures are ex-ante appraisal estimates, not actual costs. For simulation it offers unit costs for building and rehabilitating irrigation, useful for investment appraisal and capacity planning models of agricultural water infrastructure. It is related to the FAO global map of irrigation areas record in this catalogue, which shows where irrigation is equipped.
